sheets.prompt:
Image 1 is a sticker of a butterfly character. Draw this exact butterfly as a cut-out paper puppet: its separate body parts laid out on one sheet, the same drawing style, colours, texture, line and proportions as in image 1, every part at the size it has in image 1.

Draw each part on its own, spread out over the sheet with wide empty gaps between them, no part touching or overlapping another:
1. the body: the fuzzy brown body, thorax and long striped abdomen, without head or wings.
2. the head: the round fuzzy head, facing the viewer, with a completely blank face — no eyes, no mouth — keep the rosy cheeks; no antennae.
3. one antenna: the curled antenna as in image 1.
4. one upper wing, alone: the upper wing on the right of image 1, orange and yellow with its blue eye spot and white-dotted border, with a rounded root, at the size and in the tilt it has in image 1.
5. one lower wing, alone: the lower wing on the right of image 1, with a rounded root, at the size it has in image 1.

The upper wing and the lower wing are two separate pieces: draw them far apart on the sheet, in different corners, with a wide empty gap between them — they must not touch or nearly touch.

Every part is drawn whole, including what is normally hidden behind another part, and each joint end (where it tucks under the body or the head) is a full, smooth, rounded edge. No text, no labels, no numbers, no outline around the parts beyond the drawing's own line, no shadows. Fully transparent background.

Image 1 is a sticker of a butterfly character; image 2 shows the same butterfly cut into puppet parts, with a blank face. Draw the butterfly's face pieces as separate stickers on one sheet: the same drawing style, colours and line as in image 1, every piece at the size it has on the butterfly in image 1, so it fits the blank face in image 2. In image 1 the butterfly looks at us, its two eyes turned in towards each other: the eye on the LEFT of image 1 has its dark iris towards its right with the white on its left and its sparkle at the top right; the eye on the RIGHT of image 1 has its dark iris towards its left with the white on its right and its sparkle at the top left.

Draw each piece on its own, upright, in three tidy rows with wide empty gaps between them, nothing touching:
Row 1, the eye on the LEFT of image 1, five times:
1. as it is in image 1: a dark oval iris with a white sparkle, the iris towards its right (the middle of the face), the white on its left.
2. wide open and surprised: bigger and rounder, looking the same way, with its white sparkle.
3. gently closed in sleep: a soft downward-curving line with a few little lashes at its outer (left) end.
4. closed in a happy smile: an upward-curving arc, like an upside-down U.
5. sad: looking down and towards the middle (the iris low and towards its right), its upper lid drooping down at its outer (left) corner and raised at its inner (right) corner.
Row 2, the eye on the RIGHT of image 1, the same five in the same order, mirrored in where they look: open, its iris towards its left (the middle of the face), the white on its right, its sparkle at the top left; asleep, its lashes at its outer (right) end; sad, looking down and towards the middle, its upper lid drooping down at its outer (right) corner and raised at its inner (left) corner.
Row 3: 11. the mouth as it is in image 1: a small happy smile. 12. the mouth wide open in a big happy laugh, the inside pink. 13. the mouth open in a small round 'o'. 14. the mouth in a small sad frown.

No text, no labels, no numbers, no shadows, no face or head around the pieces. Fully transparent background.
